name: ETL Adjust Raw Data Export to Snowflake
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Adjust Raw Data Export** as the data source.
2.  Select your added Snowflake data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your GCS Bucket using the **(+)** icon with your **Project ID, Region & Bucket Name.**
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/adjust-dataexport/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
